country.evidence_quote: Since 2018, Malta Design has been the reference partner for premium public space delivery in Malta. We design, supply and install public spaces built to last, including playgrounds, urban furniture, sport circuits and heritage sites across the Maltese islands. Our work supports local councils, public institutions, architects and developers shaping the country’s outdoor environment.
